$comment: Freeplast frozen v6 design contract (issue #12). Extracted verbatim from the approved prototype propuesta-textos-originales (https://mliu.site/freeplast/v6/) — see DECISIONS.md for sources, SHA-256 hashes and the recorded theme adaptations. The theme must implement these tokens; the obsolete v5 editorial rules (Newsreader/Outfit, square geometry, hairline rules) must not be used.

roles.cards: 3xl (prototype plates) / lg (compact WordPress cards with nested forms — see DECISIONS.md)

shape.shadows: only on hover/elevation of cards and the island (soft blue-tinted); none on controls

motion.reducedMotion: nonessential motion disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce

button.variantGhost: transparent bg, blue text, line-strong border
button.variantGreen: green bg (hover green-soft) — accent variant, not the default

input.focus: blue border + 3px rgba(16,0,144,0.14) ring, no default outline

controls.focusVisible: 2px solid blue outline, offset 2px (green-soft on dark surfaces)
controls.targets: primary actions >= 44px, chips and nav controls comfortable to the touch

navigation.composition: island: logo/INICIO, NOSOTROS, TIENDA (desktop), Cotiza Online CTA / Cotización count, burger (< 900px)
navigation.mobileSheet: fullscreen glass overlay (blur 48px), large nav labels, contact foot

routes.Contacto: /contacto/ (site navigation and footer per the v6 composition)

navigation.activeState: aria-current on the active filter/link; blue chip background

interactions.hover: color/border shifts + gentle lift; card media scale 1.04
interactions.cards: hover elevate with soft blue shadow; active press
interactions.forms: authoritative server POST; JavaScript only enhances (basket); inline validation states use blue/tint, never red-only failure
interactions.emptyStates: tinted bordered panels naming the situation and offering recovery links
interactions.progressiveEnhancement: shell navigates and quotes without any JavaScript

v5.rules: Newsreader display face, Outfit UI face, square geometry, pills forbidden, hairline rules, paper editorial grid
